data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Firebase Realtime Database with offline access and realtime syncing.
data.what_it_does: Connects your Flutter app to the Firebase Realtime Database, allowing you to store and sync data in JSON format across clients in real time. It supports offline access and multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, Windows, and macOS.
use_when: You need real-time data synchronization across clients
You are already using Firebase as your backend service
You require offline data persistence capabilities
avoid_when: You need complex relational querying and SQL joins
You are not using Firebase for your backend infrastructure
weaknesses: Limited querying capabilities compared to SQL databases
Tied directly to the Firebase ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Firebase for your project, adding the required native dependencies, and initializing firebase_core.

alternatives.name: postgrest
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a PostgreSQL-backed relational database alternative via Supabase.
